title: Which button takes the lift from floor negative two up to floor two?
description: The lift starts below the ground and must reach the Art Centre above it, crossing the ground floor on the way. The movement is the target floor take away the starting floor, and the shaft shows the climb in two parts. Keeko's doubt is that the starting floor is written first in the take away.
teaching_notes: One idea: the target floor is written first in the take away, so a ride up gives a positive button. Watch for students who write the starting floor first and get a negative button for a ride that goes up.

source: If the Target Floor is +2 and Starting Floor is −2, what but
video_script.why: The child finds a button press that crosses the ground floor going up, and checks the order of the take away.
video_script.substitution: Use the book's own floors: starting floor negative two and target floor positive two, the Art Centre.
video_script.anchor: the lift in {{NAME_10}} going up from floor negative two to the Art Centre at floor positive two
video_script.wrong_move: takes the target floor away from the starting floor, which gives a button that sends the lift down
video_script.payoff_line: The button press is positive four.

names.{{NAME_10}}: the building with floors above and below the ground

maths_rules: movement needed = target floor - starting floor = (+2) - (-2)
(-2) + ? = (+2): 2 floors up to 0, then 2 more up, so 4 floors up, ? = +4
slip: (-2) - (+2) = -4 sends the lift down to floor -6
video_script.design: The shaft shows floor negative two, the ground floor and the Art Centre, with one arrow going up in two parts.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; the lift shaft with the lift at floor -2 and the Art Centre at floor +2

marks.scene: the title card arrives and the lift shaft is drawn
marks.start: the lift stops at floor -2 below the ground
marks.ask: the Art Centre at floor +2 lights up and a button panel appears with a question mark

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about the lift in {{NAME_10}}.
<bookmark mark='start'/>The lift is at floor negative two, below the ground.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>It has to reach the Art Centre, floor positive two. Which button should be pressed?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: the shaft with floors -2, -1, 0, 1, 2; the ground floor 0 marked; Starting floor + movement = Target floor

marks.cross: the ground floor, zero, is marked on the shaft
marks.rule: the line Starting floor + movement = Target floor is written

narration: <bookmark mark='cross'/>To go from a floor below the ground to one above it, the lift passes the ground floor.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>As before, the starting floor plus the movement gives the target floor.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the target floor is positive two, and the starting floor is negative two.

beats.on_screen: To find: the button press (movement needed)

marks.find: the words button press are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the button press, which is the movement needed.

beats.on_screen: Movement needed = target floor - starting floor

marks.rule: the rule target floor take away starting floor is written

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step one, the movement needed is the target floor take away the starting floor.

marks.vals: the two floors are put in: (+2) - (-2)

narration: <bookmark mark='vals'/>Step two, put in the floors. We write positive two take away negative two.

beats.on_screen: (-2) + ? = (+2); an arrow from floor -2 up past 0 to floor +2

marks.arrow: an arrow rises from floor -2 past the ground to floor +2

narration: <bookmark mark='miss'/>Step three, read it on the shaft, negative two plus a missing movement equals positive two.
<bookmark mark='arrow'/>The lift goes up two floors to the ground, and two more floors above it.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The button press is positive four.
<bookmark mark='check'/>Check it, negative two plus positive four lands on positive two.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: -4 crossed out; an arrow from floor -2 going down to floor -6, away from floor +2

marks.down: an arrow falls from floor -2 to floor -6
marks.fix: the button is struck out and the target floor moves to the front

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the button is negative four, after taking the target floor away from the starting floor.
<bookmark mark='down'/>A negative button sends the lift down, from floor negative two to floor negative six.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>The Art Centre is above, so the target floor must come first, and the button is positive four.
